verdict.rationale: Kick's docs explicitly state AI auto-categorizes ~97% of transactions on first pass, learns from user corrections, and lets users create Rules that override AI categorization permanently for future matching transactions — directly matching the story's requirement for learning-based categorization suggestions. Confidence gating (low-confidence transactions left uncategorized) further supports a learning/feedback loop. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of the learning accuracy or how quickly corrections propagate, and no detail on the mechanism (per-vendor vs. global learning).
